title: Encoder swap: DINOv3 views in place of the DINOv2 views (no tuning), development splits only
written_before: any DINOv3 weight was downloaded and any DINOv3 feature or score was computed
question: What happens to frozen REPRISE v5 and to the locked two-sided propagation (selection_lock_p5.json) when the two DINOv2 views (ViT-B/14, ViT-L/14) are replaced by DINOv3 views (ViT-B/16, ViT-L/16)?
status: Descriptive comparison on development data. dev1 was used for selection in every earlier phase and dev2 for the Phase 5 confirmation (attempt 1); all hyper-parameters were chosen with DINOv2 features, so the comparison is, if anything, tilted towards DINOv2. Nothing is selected in this phase; every pre-specified comparison is reported. The result supports no claim on unused data and does not change the Phase 5 lock; it is not a Phase 5 confirmation attempt.
not_used: OpenOOD v1.5 test (6 uses so far)

encoders.source: Hugging Face hub, timm organisation (not gated), file model.safetensors, DINOv3 License; download approved by the user on 2026-10-03
encoders.not_downloaded: ViT-H+/16 (permission was given for B/16 and L/16 only); ViT-7B/16 does not fit an 11 GB GPU

feature: CLS token after the final norm (timm forward_features()[:, 0]; token 0 is the class token, tokens 1-4 are registers), L2-normalised, float32; fp32 inference, TF32 off. This mirrors x_norm_clstoken of the DINOv2 pipeline. (timm's default pooling for these models is the patch mean; it is not used.)

primary (run d3).input: Resize(293, bicubic) + CenterCrop(256) + ImageNet normalisation: the centre-crop ratio of the DINOv2 pipeline (0.875), 256 patch tokens (as DINOv2 /14 at 224 px), the resolution DINOv3 was trained at

sensitivity (run d3s).input: the exact DINOv2 input: Resize(256, bicubic) + CenterCrop(224) (196 patch tokens)

unchanged: Everything except the two views: R5 shots (5 draws, 12 support + 4 calibration per class), CLIP zero-shot candidate classes (K = 20), n0 = 48, m = 1, entrance thresholds (0.3, 0.2, 0.10191613435745239), graph k = 10, gamma = 1, lambda = 0.9, 15 sweeps; the two-sided propagation exactly as in selection_lock_p5.json (sha256 8fea3cbd77104a63dd40c3ec98c22290ca0204c9b6da3ae48ab2fdb218f6ae4a); TINS and MCM scores; streams, orders (seeds 123, 124, 125) and batches.

runs.dev1: lock (new run, same code path), d3, d3s
runs.tasks: 5 draws x {near, far} x 3 orders per run and split

metrics: AUROC and FPR95 (threshold accepting 95% of ID); standalone (no base detector), x TINS, x MCM; unit = support draw (the three orders averaged); paired difference DINOv3 - DINOv2 with a 95% t interval (df = 4)
primary_comparisons: P1: v5, standalone, near FPR95, dev2, d3 - lock
P2: two-sided, standalone, near FPR95, dev2, d3 - lock
secondary: gain of the two-sided propagation over v5 within each encoder
single-view read-outs (B only, L only) of the same runs
seed-set statistics of the two-sided method (ID share, OOD share, purity)
reading_rule: A difference is called an improvement (deterioration) only if its 95% interval excludes 0; otherwise 'no clear difference'. No hyper-parameter, view or preprocessing is changed after a dev score has been seen; any later variation is labelled post hoc.
sanity_gate_before_scoring: Nearest-class-mean accuracy of the calibration shots (prototypes = mean of the 12 support shots, ID classes of dev1, train images only). The dev runs start only if every DINOv3 view reaches at least 50% (a broken read-out gives chance level, 0.1%); the accuracies are reported.
